title: Length Bound for Packed Fields
statement: Let $ws$ be a finite list of Boolean words and let $W\in\mathbb N$. If every word in $ws$ has length at most $W$, then the packed encoding of $ws$ has length at most $|ws|(2W+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $ws$ of Boolean words
Every word in $ws$ has length at most $W$
replaced: For every list of words with all payloads of length at most $W$, the packed encoding has length at most the list length times $2W + 2$; each field stores its doubled payload plus two separator bits.
